list.emptyDescription: Create the first entry to start filling this collection.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: The entry is removed, and unpublished if it was live. This cannot be undone.

reorder.hint: Drag the handle beside an entry, or focus it and press Space, to set the order. Lists that show these entries are republished.
reorder.failed: The order could not be saved. It has been restored.

missing.title: Collection not found
missing.description: This collection is not defined on this site.

toggle.publishedOn_one: {{field}} is on for {{name}} and live. It used {{count}} KV write.
toggle.publishedOn_other: {{field}} is on for {{name}} and live. It used {{count}} KV writes.
toggle.publishedOff_one: {{field}} is off for {{name}} and live. It used {{count}} KV write.
toggle.publishedOff_other: {{field}} is off for {{name}} and live. It used {{count}} KV writes.
toggle.draftOn: {{field}} is on for {{name}}. The entry is a draft, so nothing went live.
toggle.draftOff: {{field}} is off for {{name}}. The entry is a draft, so nothing went live.
toggle.failed: The switch could not be saved. The list has been refreshed.

confirm.title: Publish with each switch?
confirm.description: Flipping a switch saves the entry and publishes only that change right away. Other unpublished edits stay unpublished.
confirm.cost_one: {{count}} published page shows this entry and will update, using {{writes}} KV writes.
confirm.cost_other: {{count}} published pages show this entry and will update, using {{writes}} KV writes.
confirm.noPages: No published page shows this entry.
confirm.limit: The free plan allows {{limit}} KV writes a day, and each switch uses some.
